description: Get the AI analysis of one scan: classification (LEGITIMATE to CONFIRMED_SCAM), scam type, risk score, confidence, impersonated brand and the key evidence behind it. The analysis is produced a few minutes after the scan completes and returns not found until then. It can disagree with the scanner's own security verdict. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.
name: get_ai_analysis
title: Get AI Analysis
